result.summary: Page is largely intact with no critical breakage, but found 3 layout issues: misaligned 'Fastest near you' cards, clipped right-edge carousel content, and bottom card obscured by tab bar.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' row are vertically misaligned - the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) sits lower than Green Bowl Pok�e9 and Trattoria Piccolo, causing uneven image tops and uneven baselines for titles and delivery fees
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the same top offset with equal image height and consistent title metadata baseline

issues.description: Right-edge content is clipped without padding: the last category pill is cut off and the third restaurant name reads 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of full name
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll end-padding and use ellipsis truncation for restaurant names so clipping does not look broken

issues.description: Bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card with '-20%' badge is cut off mid-image by the bottom tab bar with no restaurant name, metadata or spacing visible
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding / safe-area inset above the tab bar so the last card can be fully scrolled into view
